title: Booking appointments
text: Book an appointment through the patient portal. Choose your appointment type, practitioner and available time. A confirmation email includes a rescheduling link. For accessibility assistance, ask the support team to create a ticket.

title: Cancellation and rescheduling policy
text: Cancel or reschedule an appointment at least 24 hours before its start through the patient portal. For a cancellation within 24 hours, contact support for a manual review. Support cannot promise that a fee will be waived.

title: Payment receipts
text: Download a payment receipt from the patient portal under Billing then Receipts. Select the appointment date and download the PDF. If a receipt is missing, request help from support; do not send card numbers in a support message.
